name: Pet care log
description: Works on a care-log CSV (date, pet, task, interval_days, weight_kg, notes). Due gives reminders (last done plus the interval); Vaccines checks vaccinations and treatments against the log or a schedule CSV you supply; Weight shows the trend; Feeding reads the daily amount off the package table you type in. NOT veterinary advice: it is date arithmetic on what you recorded and does not know your animal. The original is never changed.

presets.label: Reminders (what is due or overdue)
presets.description: For every pet and task: last done, interval, next due date, and overdue / due soon / fine. Extra arguments: today=YYYY-MM-DD within=30. Tasks without an interval_days are listed separately.

presets.label: Vaccination and treatment check
presets.description: Overdue and upcoming vaccinations, worming, flea and tick treatments from the log. Extra argument schedule=FILE.csv (task, interval_days) checks against the schedule your vet gave you and lists what was never recorded or given too early. Not veterinary advice.

presets.label: Weight trend
presets.description: First and last weight, change, change per month and the last three readings for each pet; mentions a change of more than 10% in about 90 days (threshold=N to change it) as something to tell the vet. Extra argument unit=kg or lb.

presets.label: Feeding amount from the package table
presets.description: Type the package guidance as guide=5:80,10:140,20:230 (kilograms:grams per day) and optionally meals=2 kcal=380 weight=12.5 pet=NAME. The amount is interpolated between the table rows and never extrapolated outside them. Package guidance only, not veterinary advice.
